exposure: Infants who received supplementary artificial milk feeds
Duration of skin-to-skin contact (SSC) with mother
cohort: 64 healthy late preterm infants born between 34 5/7 and 36 6/7 weeks of gestation
finding: The study found that birthweight, time of birth, mode of delivery, and breastfeeding status were associated with the duration of SSC provided by fathers, while only birthweight was associated with the duration of SSC provided by mothers.
mod_finding: Infants born by cesarean section had significantly longer durations of SSC with their fathers on the first day after birth.
